evals.prompt: Optimize the design of https://example.com for both users and AI agents in one go. I'm fine with sending the URL to the agent-readiness scanner. Put the output in /tmp/do-run.
evals.expected_output: One run: preflight, a single intake into /tmp/do-run/evidence, website-agent-readiness scans once after G1, owners finalized as case A, ux-ax-review runs with clarity and the three scan-covered AX checks (robots-sitemap, markdown-pages, crawler-access) skipped, then dont-make-me-think and viral-product-evaluator, and one merged design-optimization.md. No repo writes.
expectations: Runs the Dependency Preflight before intake: dont-make-me-think and ux-ax-review required, website-agent-readiness and viral-product-evaluator optional, frontend-design deferred until apply, and the lease session released in finally.
Captures page.html, head.json, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt once into the evidence dir and writes manifest.json.
Presents website-agent-readiness's G1 third-party-send gate before any scan.
Finalizes manifest owners after the scan and before ux-ax-review runs.
Passes ux-ax-review skip-checks of clarity,robots-sitemap,markdown-pages,crawler-access.
Does not put structured-data, llms-txt or ai-actions in ux-ax-review skip-checks; ux-ax-review keeps them and any scan result for them is cited as corroboration.

Reads each member's result from its own closing signal (the Result: line for ux-ax-review, viral-product-evaluator and website-agent-readiness; the **Result:** line under the Orchestrated-by line in dont-make-me-think's report) and reports it.
Writes a single design-optimization.md with one row per finding and the owner cited, and the Members line marks each member with its own Result status.
The closing response opens with a Result: PASS | PARTIAL | BLOCKED line, then Evidence naming the manifest and member report paths, Uncertainty, and the apply offer by finding ID as the Decision.
Stops with an apply offer by finding ID and does not edit any source file.

evals.name: dedup-capture-once
evals.prompt: Run a full design optimization on https://shop.example.com — usability, UX/AX, virality and agent readiness. Make sure nothing is fetched or scanned twice.
evals.expected_output: States that the page is captured once into the evidence dir and every member reads it via evidence-dir; website-agent-readiness scans once and its scan.json is reused; duplicate findings across members are merged into one row under the owner.
expectations: Every member invocation carries orchestrated-by: design-optimizer and the same evidence-dir.
No member re-fetches page.html, robots.txt, sitemap.xml or llms.txt listed in manifest.files.
website-agent-readiness posts to isitagentready.com at most once.
A defect reported by two members appears as one row with the other member under 'Also reported by'.
Every canonical check ID appears exactly once across Findings, Skipped and Not covered.

A dont-make-me-think issue whose title or Where line names the same element as a ux-ax-review Visual-system item and whose title or Problem line contains that item's effect word appears on that brand row as 'Also reported by: dont-make-me-think ("<issue title>"; Where: ...)', not as a separate row, with no invented lens number or #N; the report has Cut list and Rules-file candidates sections citing ux-ax-review F/T IDs and the dont-make-me-think issue title.

evals.name: g1-declined
evals.prompt: Optimize my landing page design at https://example.org but do not send my URL to any third-party scanner.
evals.expected_output: Website-agent-readiness G1 is declined (case B): no scan, ux-ax-review keeps all AX checks and skips only clarity; agent-readiness-scan is listed as not covered because the user declined the send.
expectations: Does not post the URL to isitagentready.com.
Passes ux-ax-review skip-checks of clarity only.
Lists agent-readiness-scan under Not covered with the reason 'user declined third-party send'.
Still produces one merged design-optimization.md.
The closing response opens with a Result line, separates the verified findings from the declined scan (named under Uncertainty or Not covered), and names the apply offer as the next decision.

evals.name: apply-needs-opt-in
evals.prompt: Optimize my app's design in ./webapp and make it look great.
evals.expected_output: Runs audit mode only and ends with an apply offer by finding ID; does not invoke frontend-design or Redesign Mode until the user explicitly opts in and names findings.
expectations: Treats the request as audit mode; no UI source file is modified.
Relays any member's closing implementation question (e.g. ux-ax-review's choice of IDs) instead of answering it for the user.
Ends with an offer to apply chosen finding IDs, stated as the Decision of the closing response.
Describes that each applied finding routes to exactly one of frontend-design or dont-make-me-think Redesign Mode behind that member's confirmation gate.

Records 'look great' as an untestable style adjective in the one-line scope, in manifest.json request.style_adjectives (status untestable) and in the report's Scope note, with a request for a design-rules file or reference screens.
Does not convert 'look great' into design decisions and never passes it to frontend-design as a brief; an apply brief would carry only the finding's ban and the evidence screenshots.

evals.prompt: Krug-review this screenshot of my signup form and tell me what's confusing.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dont-make-me-think alone; design-optimizer does not trigger, no evidence dir, no multi-member run.
expectations: dont-make-me-think handles the request directly.
No orchestrated multi-member audit or design-optimization.md is produced.

evals.prompt: Scan https://example.com with isitagentready and file issues for the gaps.
evals.expected_output: Routes to website-agent-readiness alone; design-optimizer does not trigger.
expectations: website-agent-readiness handles the request with its own gates.
No design-optimizer intake or merged report is produced.

evals.prompt: Build a React pricing page component with three tiers.
evals.expected_output: Routes to frontend-design for a UI build; design-optimizer does not trigger and no audit runs.
expectations: No audit, evidence capture or merged report is produced.
The response is a UI build, not a design optimization run.

evals.name: manifest-dark-and-build
evals.prompt: Optimize the design of https://my-app-git-feature-x.vercel.app — it's a preview deploy, and the app has a dark mode. Output to /tmp/do-dark.
evals.expected_output: Intake writes manifest.json with the light screenshots under files.screenshots, the dark ones under files["screenshots-dark"] (or that entry skipped with a reason when the browser cannot emulate the dark scheme), and build {kind: preview, basis} from the user's statement and the *.vercel.app host; the merged report labels the capture as a preview, never production.
expectations: manifest.json keeps files.screenshots as {status: ok, files: [desktop.png, mobile.png]} (or skipped with a reason) and does not rename the light screenshots.

manifest.json has files["screenshots-dark"] either as {status: ok, files: [desktop-dark.png, mobile-dark.png]} or as {status: skipped, reason} naming why (browse not installed, browser cannot emulate color scheme, product offers no dark scheme, or target has no render); a missing dark capture is never fatal.
manifest.json has a top-level build object with kind 'preview' and a basis naming the user's statement or the *.vercel.app host pattern.
The merged design-optimization.md labels the evidence as a preview build and never presents it as production.

evals.name: apply-ban-brief-recheck
evals.prompt: Here's the design-optimization.md from the last run on https://example.com (D-03: brand, "New" badge beside the hero CTA, ux-ax-review F3, dark screenshots captured, build production). Apply D-03 and make it look modern.
evals.expected_output: Routes D-03 to frontend-design with a brief holding only the finding's ban, the evidence screenshot paths (light and dark) and the build line; 'modern' is recorded as untestable and never relayed. frontend-design's own approval, diff-and-confirm gate and checks still run, and the fix is reported done only after a COMPLETE frontend-design visual check covering the affected views and dark mode, or a scoped ux-ax-review re-run whose brand coverage is tested and no longer names the badge; otherwise 'applied, not verified: <reason>'.
expectations: The frontend-design brief carries only the D-03 ban (remove the "New" badge beside the hero CTA; do not add a substitute effect), the finding ID and member reason quoted as data, the evidence screenshot paths including desktop-dark.png and mobile-dark.png, and the manifest's build line.
'modern' is not relayed to frontend-design in any form; it is recorded as an untestable style adjective with a request for a design-rules file or reference screens.
frontend-design's own direction approval, diff-and-confirm gate, Repo Sync and verification checks still run; design-optimizer does not edit UI files or judge the result itself.

The fix is reported done only when frontend-design's Final Report has Result: COMPLETE and its Evidence line lists the visual check for the affected views and dark mode, or when a ux-ax-review re-run scoped to brand (skip-checks of the other eleven aspects, fresh capture and output-dir of its own) has brand coverage tested (not not-tested) and no finding naming the badge.

A frontend-design PARTIAL or 'Visual check untested' result with no passing re-run is reported as 'applied, not verified: <reason>', never done, in the Apply step report and the closing Decision line.

evals.name: same-element-different-defect
evals.prompt: Run a full design optimization on https://example.com. dont-make-me-think and ux-ax-review both flag the hero CTA: ux-ax-review has a Competing-effects item for a "New" badge beside it, dont-make-me-think says its label "Learn more" doesn't say what happens.
evals.expected_output: The ux-ax-review badge item becomes the brand row. The dont-make-me-think CTA-label issue names the same element but not the badge, so it keeps its own clarity row (optionally noting related: the brand row), routes to dont-make-me-think Redesign Mode, and is not cited on the brand row or the Cut list.
expectations: The hero CTA badge appears as a brand row owned by ux-ax-review.
The dont-make-me-think "Learn more" CTA-label issue keeps its own clarity row with fix route Redesign Mode; it is not listed under 'Also reported by' on the brand row.
The Cut list cites only the ux-ax-review badge item; the CTA itself and the clarity issue are not on the Cut list.
The merge rests on quoted element and effect words from the member reports; design-optimizer does not reclassify either finding by its own judgment.
